# FG-AIASSET-0009

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `rollback_targets_last_approved` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この AI 資産のリリースはこの環境にデプロイできません。段の順（影 → カナリア → 本番）と承認の設定を確かめてください。
- en: This AI asset release cannot be deployed to this environment. Check the stage order (shadow, canary, production) and the approval settings.
- id: Rilis aset AI ini tidak dapat di-deploy ke lingkungan ini. Periksa urutan tahap (shadow, canary, produksi) dan pengaturan persetujuan.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 17 P17-7 §1.9 (ADR-0031 Amendment P17-7): a project whose `ai_assets.enabled` is on deploys only signed `pfs-ai-bundle` releases, through the release routes, to the three stages dev = pfs-ai-shadow, stg = pfs-ai-canary, prod = pfs-ai-prod, each requiring a person's approval, in order (canary needs the release succeeded on shadow, prod on canary). `reason`: `release_required` (a plain SHA request or an automatic deployment in such a project), `release_not_found`, `approval_required` (the environment does not require an approval), `stage_skipped` (with `needs`: the earlier stage it has not succeeded on), `no_rollback_target` (no earlier release succeeded with an approval on that environment), `already_current` (the rollback target is what runs). Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The route logs `forge.deploy.bundle_deploy_refused` with `error_code=FG-AIASSET-0009`, `request_id`, `project_id`, `environment`, `version` and `reason`. Read: SELECT d.id, d.tier, d.sha, d.status, d.approved_by FROM forge.deployments d WHERE d.project_id = <id> ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT 20; SELECT tier, requires_approval FROM forge.deploy_environments WHERE project_id = <id>;

## 対処 (fix)

Deploy the release to the earlier stage first and wait for it to succeed, set the environment to require an approval, or request the release through POST …/ai-asset-releases/{version}/deployments. A rollback needs an earlier approved release on that environment.
